summary:
# Certified single-sweep closed mesh

Consumer-only commit `b65572f7e316c865d5069ae0ab1fac792918b743` adds two files in `csg/offset`. Qualification uses the provided `sweep-object-for-mesh.patch` as a geometry prerequisite.

One original boundary tensor index identifies each vertex, including the edges and corners shared by analytic faces. U/V stations are represented original parameters and displacement stations remain exact rationals through evaluation. The source face supplies the outward winding. A common rational box for each continuous cell and its actual stored vertex positions encloses both the cell and its flattened triangles. Each wall bounds a positive inward UV collar that shrinks with refinement. The largest squared diameter gives the two-sided distance certificate. The exact indexed locator independently proves the final single closed embedded shell and its positive signed mesh volume.

| Control | Request | Grid (U × V × displacement) | Triangles | Certified distance |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Slab with exact displacement from −1/7 to 2/7 | .2 | 8 × 8 × 8 | 768 | 0.176776695298 |
| Parabolic strip, original and signed-rotated placement | .16 | 8 × 8 × 4 | 512 | 0.149536975717 |
| Same rational slab | .05 | 32 × 32 × 32 | 12,288 | 0.044194173825 |
| Same parabolic strip, both placements | .05 | 32 × 32 × 8 | 6,144 | 0.042795389419 |

The slab preserves the exact 1/14 displacement midpoint and exact represented signed volume. A one-cell check measures the squared bound as 2 plus the squared rounding of the upper displacement. The curved sweep's analytic volume is 0.1040228819434551. Its exact represented signed volume is 0.1040083244367250 at the default deflection and the sampled continuous deviation is below 0.000110052. Invalid representation, cancellation, and triangle, depth, analytic work and collision exhaustion all return an empty result.

Full `csg/offset` native tests passed in 13.877 seconds. The focused sweep and stitched atlas race passed in 6.130 seconds. Vet passed. Eight previously recorded grid and options digests match. The default-distance audit is an evidence overlay. No geometry or existing mesh code is included in the consumer patch.
